import pandas as pd, glob
from datetime import timedelta
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
res=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=f.split('/')[-1].split('.')[0]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  dt=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc)+d.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours).map(pd.to_timedelta,unit='h')
  at=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc.fillna('00:00'))+d.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours).map(pd.to_timedelta,unit='h')
 else:
  dt=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep)
  at=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep.fillna('00:00'))
 localdate=dt.dt.date
 comp=~d.cancelled.astype(bool)
 # local actual time datetime based UTC conversion already date can differ; for local standard files date + clock
 diff=(at-dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
 # For cross midnight, convert negative to +1440 (but may turn early departures into huge delay)
 cross=(diff<0)&(diff+1440>15)
 diff_adj=diff.where(~cross,diff+1440)
 feb=localdate.astype(str).str.startswith('2025-02')
 x=d[feb & comp]
 res.append((c,len(d),sum(feb),sum(feb&comp),sum((feb&comp)&(diff>15)),sum((feb&comp)&(diff_adj>15)),sum((feb&comp)&cross),diff[feb&comp].min(),diff[feb&comp].max()))
print(pd.DataFrame(res,columns=['carrier','dedup_total','feb_total','completed','raw_delayed','adj_delayed','cross_candidates','min','max']).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, glob
from datetime import timedelta
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport'); out=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=f.split('/')[-1].split('.')[0]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  offs=d.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours).map(pd.to_timedelta,unit='h')
  st=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc)+offs
  ac=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc.fillna('00:00'))+offs
 else:
  st=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep); ac=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep.fillna('00:00'))
 diff=(ac-st).dt.total_seconds()/60
 # midnight rollover in exported same-date clock fields; only very negative values are rollover, preserve modest early departures
 diff=diff.where(diff>=-60,diff+1440)
 dates=st.dt.strftime('%Y-%m'); sel=(dates=='2025-02') & (~d.cancelled.astype(bool))
 n=sel.sum(); delayed=(sel & (diff>15)).sum()
 out.append((c,delayed,n,round(100*delayed/n,1)))
 print(c, sorted(diff[sel & (diff<0)].tolist())[:10])
print('RESULT',out)

events.notes: Computed from February 2025 flights after deduplicating repeated flight_id records. Cancelled flights were excluded from both numerator and denominator; delays were counted only when departure delay exceeded 15 minutes. AS timestamps were converted from UTC to local origin time using airport offsets, and overnight departures were handled as next-day departures.
